purpose: Repair the proven double-terminal-completion lifecycle for notify-owned background jobs.
live_root_cause: Two semantic terminal completion authorities are claimed for ONE notify-owned background job. The originating turn synchronously waits the job to terminal state via `command_status(J, waitMs=30000)` and calls `submit_and_exit`. The wake-driven turn also runs `submit_and_exit`. submit_and_exit count for J = 2.

red_proof.primary_observation: When Path A enqueues a wake via fire-and-forget and Path B fires resolveObligation synchronously, the discard seam returns `not_found` because the wake has not yet landed. The wake survives and proceeds to start a second autonomous turn.
red_proof.control_observation: When the enqueue is synchronous (TQCB-CTL-DUAL-2 baseline), the discard succeeds. The defect is the fire-and-forget seam, not the coordinator's marker arbitration.

selected_authority_model.name: H1
selected_authority_model.description: For notify-owned active jobs, command_status(J, waitMs>0) returns state=running with a structured `notification: "pending"` payload. The originating turn cannot synchronously wait a notify-owned job to terminal state. The wake owns terminal-completion authority by definition.
selected_authority_model.rationale: Matches user intent ('notify me when it finishes'). Eliminates the fire-and-forget race at the tool layer. No model dependence. Smallest bounded change.
